rv.q: Drury Lane’s production should satisfy fans of classic thrillers and murder mysteries.
This isn’t just a thriller—it’s a taut exploration of control, vulnerability, and the artful menace of manipulation.
Adam Immerwahr’s tension-filled Thriller will give theatergoers the shivers and, as the worried observer, will keep them on the edge of their seats.
With all the fixings one would expect from a classic “whodunit” but with a refreshing update, the only mystery is why you haven’t bought tickets already.
The result is a stylish, superbly acted evening that breathes new life into a classic.
This is a delightfully strong, talented, and masterful cast.
Suspenseful and slyly humorous, Hatcher’s version is also deliciously theatrical...
Hellman delivers a mesmerizing performance as the cunning and sinister Tony Wendice, capturing the character's diabolical essence.
All in all, I truly think you will walk away knowing that you were witness to a sterling production.
